title: Pigot's Monmouthshire Directory 1844
narrative:
TO TREDEGAR,BLACKWOOD, YNISDRE, Cardiff and Risca, the Tredegar Co. from their wharf. High street, daily & Henry Morgan & John Price, Friday-and Monday & Friday.

To BRISTOL, the Moderator, every Monday, Tuesday, Friday & Saturday, from the Moderator wharf.masters various—John Passmore Rowe, agent and part owner.

To CARDIFF, the Robert, S. Clampill, master, once a week—and the Sister, Captain Fifoot, once a week, from the Tredegar wharf—John W. Bebell,agent.

To GLOUCESTER, and from thence per Railway and Canal, to LIVERPOOL, MANCHESTER, BIRMINGHAM, WORCESTER, SHEFFIELD, the POTTERIES, DERBY, SHARDLOW and all parts of the North, Henry Sonthan and Son, from Tredegar wharf—John Wilson Bebell, agent.—By this conveyance, goods are forwarded from all parts of the North of England to South Wales.

To ABERGAFENNY, the Moderator Company's Boats, from the Moderator wharf, every Tuesday & Friday-Thos. Richards' boats, from the Tredegar Boat Company's wharf Prosser & Co.'s boats, from two Bristol Packet wharf, and Ann Prosser's from the Moderator wharf, every Monday morning at 4.—John W. Bebell, agent.

To BRECON, BUILTII, Crickhowell, Hay, Llandovery, Landoilo, Llangattock, Rhavader, Talgarth, Talybont, Trecastle, Derynock, Bronlis, Lanvigan, Langunider, Glasbury, Penbont, Penkerrig, Howey, Pentrefeilin, Langone, Mothervey, Penoyre, Lyswen, Laugamarch and Edward, Ann Prosser's Boat, from the Moderator wharf, every Monday-and 'North & Co.'s Boats, from the Tredegar Boat Company's wharf, every Wednesday—William Wild, agent

To GOVILON, CRICKHOWELL,Llangattock, Nant-y-glo, Tredegar, Llanvihangel, Longtown, Monmouth Cap, Llandilio, Bertholey, Clydach, Brynmawr, Wainlygan, Beaufort and Ebbw Vale, the Moderator Company's Boats, from the Moderator wharf, every Tuesday and Friday.

To PONTYPOOL,PONTYMOIL,Aber-sychan, Varteg, Cwmavon, Talawayne and B'aenavon, Thomas Rees' Boat, from the Tredegar Boat Co.'s wharf, twice a week—& Lewis Bevan's boat, from the Moderator wharf, every Saturday—John Wilson Bebell, agent.

To BIRMINGHAM, the From (Car-dif) calls at the King's Head Inn,every Monday, Wednesday and Friday morning at eight; goes through Usk, Monmouth, Ross, Ledbury, Malvern and Worcester.

To BRISTOL, the Cymro (from Swansea) calls alternately at the King's Head Inn and the Westgate Inn, afternoon(Sunday excepted) at one; goes thro' Chepstow.

To CARDIFF, the Hero (from Birming-ham) calls at the King's Head Inn, every evening at eight—and Omnibuses, from the Tredegar Arms, every morning at eight and afternoon at four (Sunday excepted).

the Cymro (from Swansea) calls at the King's Head Inn and the Westgate Inn, on alternate afternoons (Sunday ex.) at one; goes thro' Chro-stow & Newnham.
